ev.q: This policy note reviews the evidence and updates CDC recommendations
Findings of randomized trials of artemisinin-based regimens for treatment of malaria in pregnancy
a systematic review of the literature was performed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of AL use during pregnancy
CDC recommends AL as an additional option for treatment of uncomplicated malaria in pregnant women

methods_quotes.q: A systematic review of English-language research articles listed in PubMed was conducted using the keywords
Clinical trials, observational studies, meta-analyses, and case reports of uncomplicated malaria treatment during pregnancy were included.
Two independent reviewers determined the relevance of each article to the research objective based first on title, then abstract, then full text.
